research.title: Robustness of Semantic Segmentation Under Image Corruptions
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to assess segmentation models under blur, sensor noise, and illumination shifts using controlled corruption protocols.
Implemented evaluation routines and augmentation ablations, examining classwise intersection over union and boundary errors to characterize sensitivity across corruption types.

work.title: Image Processing and Validation for Inspection Workflows
bullets: Implemented image ingestion and preprocessing components for inspection workflows, handling inconsistent file formats, missing metadata, and malformed uploads.
Maintained regression tests for image transformations and investigated processing failures through log review, reproducible test cases, and documented fixes.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Classification Transfer Learning
bullets: Implemented frozen feature extraction and partial fine tuning for pretrained image classifiers using shared data splits and consistent preprocessing.
Compared classification errors across adaptation strategies, inspecting confusion matrices and learning curves to identify overfitting and visually ambiguous categories.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented an image alignment pipeline using local descriptors, nearest neighbor matching, and robust homography estimation for overlapping image pairs.
Compared descriptor matching thresholds and outlier rejection settings, examining reprojection errors and alignment failures under viewpoint changes and repetitive textures.

projects.title: Classical and Learned Methods for Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented bilateral filtering and a convolutional denoising autoencoder, constructing paired clean and corrupted images with controlled synthetic noise.
Compared reconstruction quality using peak signal to noise ratio and structural similarity, inspecting edge preservation and artifacts across noise conditions.
